name: Fire Bolt
blurb: Cantrip. Hits one spot and lights anything flammable there.

name: Ray of Frost
blurb: Cantrip, here a short beam. Freezes water into walkable ice and snuffs fire. RAW it only chills a creature; the ice is our physical reading.

name: Shocking Grasp
blurb: Cantrip. Lightning travels through water and metal that touch the spot.

name: Gust of Wind
blurb: A 60 ft line of wind. Pushes light things, blows out small flames, fans big ones, drives windmills.

name: Grease
blurb: A slick 10 ft square. Things slide across it. Flammable here, as in BG3; check the SRD text before relying on that.

name: Create Water
blurb: Pours water that flows downhill, fills pits and boilers, douses fire, and soaks creatures.

name: Thunderwave
blurb: A 15 ft cube of force. Throws everything within reach away from the centre, even a boulder, a little.

name: Levitate
blurb: One thing floats for a while. It ignores pits and slick ground, and the lightest gust carries it.

name: Mage Hand
blurb: Pick up something light (tap it), then set it down within 30 ft (tap the spot).
